description: ⚡Enjoy the freedom to unlock financial, paginated, pivot, and IBCS reporting with self-service analytics—fully code-free and powerful! Experience next-level reporting with Inforiver Matrix visual—offering seamless hierarchy, flexible layouts, and rich formatting. Empower your team to build interactive, professional reports without needing to write any code, DAX, or Power Query—delivering clear, impactful analytics every time. Perfect for business users and analysts who demand speed, precision, and ease. It supports data input, forecasting, goal-seek functionality, and export options, making it ideal for planning, budgeting, and analytical reporting. Inforiver also adheres to IBCS standards, ensuring consistent, professional, and visually clear reports. 💡 Discover Why Inforiver Leads in Modern Analytics: 🚀 Build interactive, well-formatted reports with an Excel-like interface—no coding required. 🌳 Display multi-level hierarchies on rows/columns with expand/collapse—works with natural and custom hierarchies. 🔄 Switch between Hierarchy, Table, Outline, Stepped, and Drilldown views with one click—no rebuilds needed. 🔀 Combine hierarchical and tabular layouts seamlessly. 📤 Export to PDF/Excel from Desktop with full formatting, hierarchies, totals, conditional styles, and visuals. Export full or selected views with customizable PDF settings—size, orientation, margins, headers,…
